lifecycle.applyingDescription: Applying changes from {{source}}. Some features may pause briefly.

recovery.preflightSummary: The app detected legacy config or plugin state before Gateway startup and repaired it automatically.
recovery.repairedSummary: A malformed Gateway config was detected. The app attempted a conservative repair before starting again.
recovery.resetSummary: A damaged Gateway config was detected. The app backed it up and rebuilt a default config before starting again.
recovery.preflightNextStep: You can keep using the app normally. If anything still looks off, check the related settings pages first.
recovery.repairedNextStep: Confirm the app is behaving normally. If something still looks off, compare the backup file with the current config.
recovery.resetNextStep: Review the default model, proxy, channels, and plugin settings. Restore anything missing from the backup if needed.
